errors.text_span: Оста X представлява времето. Скалата е линейна и обхвана стойностите от 2004 до 2019 г., като спира в 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states there is a single X-axis. The figure contains two separate plots, one for "Внос" (Imports) and one for "Износ" (Exports), each with its own time axis from 2004 to 2019.

The description incorrectly names a data series "Експорт" (Export). There is no such line in the legend. The dotted line represents "ЕС" (EU). "Експорт" ("Износ" in the chart) is a category for the right-hand plot, not a data series.
The description completely omits the data series for "Извън ЕС" (Outside EU), which is represented by the dashed line in both plots.

errors.text_span: започваща при стойност около 28% през 2004 г.
errors.evidence: The description claims the 'Общо' line starts at 28% in 2004. In the 'Внос' (Imports) chart, it starts at approximately 15%, and in the 'Износ' (Exports) chart, it starts at approximately 24%.

The description incorrectly attributes a peak of over 65% to the 'Общо' (Total) line. The 'Общо' line's peak is around 42%. The peak of over 60% belongs to the 'Извън ЕС' (Outside EU) line in the 'Внос' (Imports) chart, which the description fails to mention.

This describes the dotted line ('ЕС', mislabeled 'Експорт'). This line never reaches a value over 35%. Its peak in the 'Внос' chart is ~28% (around 2012) and in the 'Износ' chart is ~30% (around 2011). The year 2008 is also incorrect for the peak.
The phrase "тъпа ивица" (dull strip) is vague and unclear. It likely intends to describe a plateau or a flat section of the line, but the wording is not standard or descriptive.
